task.title: Replace partial-assign recovery with governed exact-id replay

scope.owned_layer: Assistant dev bridge exact failed-leaf recovery, authoritative post-assign readback, isolated bridge test roots/audits, CLI, regressions, and task evidence.
scope.not_changing: No live packet recovery, live audit cleanup, canonical state edit, supervisor scheduling, fleet policy, runtime promotion, downstream task dispatch, or admission schema change.

delivered_properties: The drain CLI supports --recover-failed-packet-id for one exact signed failed leaf and does not drain it implicitly.
Recovery holds the inbox queue lock plus packet processing and dispatch fences; operators do not move or edit queue, failed, receipt, admission, replay, or canonical-state files.
A durable prepared marker precedes failed-to-pending rename; retry completes prepared markers after crashes on either side of rename.
Recovery identity binds packet digest, signature, actor, mode, intent, source conversation and turns, documents, constraints, task specs, owners, reviewers, and task-spec hashes.
Pending, processing, processed, failed, receipt, admission, replay, claim, retry, and live-fence collisions fail closed unless they are the exact durable idempotent recovery state.
Governed dispatch reads existing rows only through the installed authoritative show command and journal parity verification; repository-local projection/archive files are never a governed fallback.
Every nonzero or timed-out governed assign receives immediate exact authoritative readback. Missing, unavailable, malformed, or mismatched readback creates no admission or replay mark.
An already materialized task cannot be rebound through a replacement packet id because exact signed bridge provenance is validated before another assign.
All focused bridge tests inherit explicit pytest-temporary status roots, audit logs, journals, command fixtures, and inboxes.

incident_record.source_task_action: No live contamination row was modified, deleted, deduplicated, or reclassified by this source repair.

later_external_observation.interpretation: Additional rows came from the rejected legacy worktree while it remained externally active; the R2 suite's syscall trace proves it did not access the live audit.

acceptance.statement: Clean R2 source-only branch from current origin/dev without rejected implementation commits.
Supported exact-id failed recovery is lock-protected, crash-consistent, idempotent, and provenance-bound.
Nonzero governed assign requires exact authoritative show and never uses repository-local fallback.
Focused tests are isolated from live audit, runtime state, and inbox.
The contamination incident is recorded without mutating its live rows.
Fresh independent Codex2 exact-head review, protected merge, and owner closeout remain.

validation.smoke_acceptance: pass after running through the checkout-scoped .venv-pantheon interpreter

independent_review.required_next_action: Codex2 must independently inspect the final PR head, update this already-committed manifest with its exact-head decision in a reviewer commit, then invoke governed approve with REVIEW_FILE and REVIEW_HEAD_SHA binding.

delivery.rollout: Merge the exact reviewed R2 head through the protected integrator. Runtime promotion and recovery of the two historical packets are separate governed operations after merge.
delivery.rollback: Revert the merged task PR, then use the normal governed runtime promotion path. Do not hand-edit live queue, receipt, admission, replay, audit, or canonical state.
